lines: - Backend-Batch (36 Dateien, alle voll gelesen, nur Huellen + `TALK TO THE HAND`): Orchestrator (`compute/__init__`, `manifest/__init__`, `rbac/__init__`, `main`, `discord_auth`, `compute/registry`, `rbac/models`, `compute/base`, `fleet_collect`, `integration`, `db`), Discord (`validation`, `pterodactyl`, `db`, `backupScheduler`, `docker`, `petCommands`, `serverLimits`, `cli-bridge`, `integration`, `serverStatus`, `ticketCommands`), CLI (`infrastructure/logs`, `apikeys`, `rollback`, `webhooks`, `plugins`, `templates`, `tui`, `secrets`, `inventory`, `ssh`, `gitops`, `infrastructure/server`, `infrastructure/deployment`, `infrastructure/__init__`). Durchgehend nicht abbildbar: Typer-Apps/`@app.command`, `async`/`await`, Klassen/`@dataclass`/`Enum`, `try/except`, Datei-/Env-/Subprozess-Zugriffe, Asserts.

+- Backend-Batch 2 (5 Dateien, alle voll gelesen, nur Huellen + `TALK TO THE HAND`): `rbac_store` (Upserts/Deletes/Batch-Load, best-effort mit Fail-Counter), `vps_manager` (Kompatibilitaets-Einstieg mit 4 Mixins), `compute/docker_provider` (Interface auf VPSManager, Lazy-Import, Status-Mapping), `rbac/engine` (CRUD + Checks + Restore, 308 Zeilen), `resource_monitor` (Legacy Docker/MySQL-Loop). Nicht abbildbar: `async`, Klassen, `try/except`, SQL, Mixins.
